TeamAvailability.workers.audience: Query.teamAvailability runs withReadableApp: App participants and the App's own key, read-only; a worker's availability goes to exactly that audience

TeamChatMessagesPage.items.audience: callers passing requireTeamChatAccess read: App participants, the App's own key, or in-org impersonation; channelMessages for App-hosted channels uses it too

TeamCompositionLane.coordinator.why: AgentTaskParty(kind,id,name,urn via partyView; worker same-App or user handle only; audience App participants+App key)

TeamCompositionWorker.worker.why: AgentTaskParty(kind,id,name,urn via partyView; worker same-App or user handle only; audience App participants+App key)

TeamRoster.workers.why: a sanitized roster row, never a Worker; admission is resolveParticipatedApp; teamPlacement, heldBy, heldAt and terminal nulled unless maySeeWorkerInternals passes, currentTask unless mayReadAppTasks passes

TeamRosterEntry.availability.audience: the roster read (withRosterAppRead / resolveParticipatedApp): App participants and the App's own key, read-only; the same audience Query.teamAvailability serves the same record to

TeamRosterEntry.heldBy.why: WorkerHolder(id,handle,urn,name; internals gated by maySeeWorkerInternals; name by canSeeUserPersonalFieldsMany)

TeamRosterEntry.reportsTo.why: AgentTaskParty(kind,id,name,urn via partyView; worker same-App or user handle only; audience App participants+App key)

TeamRosterEntry.worker.why: AgentTaskParty(kind,id,name,urn via partyView; worker same-App or user handle only; audience App participants+App key)

TickerPage.items.audience: App participants (resolveParticipatedApp), the gate of Query.ticker, or a host key limited to tickers its host's workers subscribe to

TickerSubscription.ticker.audience: reached via Ticker.subscribers, workerWakeSettings (participants only) and subscribe mutations (participants); each caller may read that ticker

TickerSubscription.worker.audience: App participants or the App's host key; subscribers limited to the host's own workers for a key

TickerSubscriptionPage.items.audience: whoever reached the Ticker (participants, or a host key limited to its host's workers); subscriptions are the ticker's own rows in the same App

UpdateMemoryMemberRolePayload.memoryMemb.audience: the memory's member-owner (requireMemoryMemberOwner); same row and field gating as addMemoryMember

UpdateMemoryShareRolePayload.memoryShare.audience: the Memory's principal (requireMemorySharePrincipal); same row family and field gating as createMemoryShare

UsageEventPage.items.audience: callers who can read the event's memory: usageEventsWhere restricts to getAccessibleMemoryIds; an explicit memoryId/nodeId must be readable

User.appMemberships.audience: Rows only when the caller is the queried user and not impersonating, else []; AppMember.app gated separately.

UserApiKeyCreateResult.userApiKey.audience: the key the caller just minted for themselves; createUserApiKey needs a user credential, not impersonation; inventory read is owner-only

UserApiKeyPage.items.audience: the owner only (userApiKeyInventoryScope: userId = ctx.userId, impersonation refused)

UserInvitation.organization.audience: returned only to a caller who passed requireOrgRole ADMIN on that org; ADMIN implies READER

UserInvitation.sender.audience: returned only by createUserInvitation/inviteUser; sender is always the calling user; nested User exception

UsersPage.items.audience: platform admins list all; others get a search-only list; name/email/personal fields nulled by the User field resolvers

WakeReason.ticker.audience: App participants read all the App's tickers, or the App's host key; a TICK reason names a ticker of one of the host's own workers

WorkerAvailability.setByParty.why: AgentTaskParty(kind,id,name,urn via partyView; worker same-App or user handle only; audience App participants+App key)

WorkerAvailability.worker.why: AgentTaskParty(kind,id,name,urn via partyView; worker same-App or user handle only; audience App participants+App key)

WorkerTerminal.host.why: id and label only: the same hostId and label HostRegistration shows to every reader of the App's tasks and events; the parent WorkerTerminal is masked unless maySeeWorkerInternals passes

WorkerWakeSettings.subscriptions.audience: WorkerWakeSettings is reached through workerForRead (App participants) or manager-only mutations; participants may also read the App's tickers

WorkerWakeSettings.worker.audience: reached via workerWakeSettings (App participant only) or the wake-settings mutations

WorkersPage.items.audience: workers: requireWorkerReadAccess on the App; heldWorkers: the workerReadableWhere form; the working-state tier, narrower than Query.worker's profile gate

AutomationTeamSnapshotGrantPage.items.why: The root automationTeamSnapshotGrants checks a live App and its manager under authority anchors before counting/paging. Items expose only that App grant audit scalars, no User/App/trigger object or private target; the same manager gate gives/revokes these rows. No independently readable entity is attached.

PrProtocolResult.task.audience: the command writer is re-gated as a participant in the task App; every participant reads all tasks of that App (cor:agt:050:21), and no App key writes these commands

GrantSignatureStatus.signatures.audience: reached only through Grant.signatureStatus by a bound worker reading its own App's grants (grant(ref:)/grants, the #3789 gate). A person listing their own grants (myGrants, #3800) is given state and integrityProblems only: this list is empty for them, withheld in the field resolver on the parent row's audience mark (gate call, #3800 P2-2); a grant's own signature records, re-verified on read

GrantSignature.signer.why: NodeRevisionEditor(handle,urn only; identity tier cor:acl:070:01); an erased signer resolves null (cor:acl:140:08)

AgentTaskExternalIdChange.task.audience: the App's readers, the same withReadableApp gate as agentTeamEvents (agentTaskExternalIdChanges reads the App's team events and the tasks they name, both scoped to that App); outsiders are refused APP_NOT_FOUND before any row

AgentTaskExternalIdChangePage.changes.audience: the App's readers, the same withReadableApp gate as agentTeamEvents (agentTaskExternalIdChanges reads the App's team events and the tasks they name, both scoped to that App); outsiders are refused APP_NOT_FOUND before any row
